responsibility: Implements the hand-generated lexical scanner for the `pge` grammar language, consuming characters from the pushback input stream and producing reserved-word and literal tokens for parser-generator processing. It owns token classification, quote and comment handling, current-token state, debugging output, and the token pushback/advance helpers that feed the parser generator.
same_name_distinction: Implements the actual pge scanner state machine: reserved-word table setup, whitespace/comment skipping, quote handling, token formation, debugging output, and token pushback behavior; gcc/m2/pge-boot/Gbnflex.h only publishes the token enum and scanner entry points.
